nodes.label: VisionTransformer
nodes.desc: ViT-B/L patch encoder (16px patches, depth 12/24) producing image embeddings

nodes.label: interpolate_pos_embed
nodes.desc: Bicubic resize of checkpoint position embeddings when image size changes

nodes.label: BertModel (MED encoder)
nodes.desc: Modified BERT that switches between unimodal text mode and multimodal cross-attention mode

nodes.label: BertLayer + crossattention
nodes.desc: Transformer layer whose cross-attention takes image embeddings as keys/values in multimodal mode

nodes.label: BertLMHeadModel
nodes.desc: Causal text decoder over image embeddings for captioning, with label-smoothed LM loss

nodes.label: BLIP_Pretrain
nodes.desc: Ties ViT + MED encoder/decoder and computes the ITC/ITM/LM loss triplet with momentum encoders and a feature queue

nodes.label: train()
nodes.desc: Pretraining loop that sums loss_ita + loss_itm + loss_lm and steps AdamW

nodes.label: MetricLogger
nodes.desc: Smoothed per-meter logging for loss_ita/loss_itm/loss_lm and lr

nodes.label: BLIP_Decoder
nodes.desc: Captioning head: ViT + BertLMHeadModel with beam-search/nucleus generate()

nodes.label: BLIP_ITM
nodes.desc: Image-text matching head: vision_proj/text_proj projections plus a 2-way itm_head

nodes.label: BLIP_VQA
nodes.desc: VQA head: multimodal question encoder + answer decoder with generate or answer-ranking inference

nodes.label: BLIP_Retrieval
nodes.desc: Retrieval head: ITC similarity plus hard-negative ITM finetuning over a 57,600-entry queue
